name: Pituitary and Adrenal Pathology: Adenomas, Cushing, Conn and Phaeochromocytoma

reference.source: Robbins Basic Pathology 9th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Lactotroph D2 tone loss hyperplasias prolactin while somatotroph GNAS drives GH; ACTH excess hyperplasias adrenals bilaterally versus autonomous adenomas suppressing ACTH, and chromaffin catecholamines spike paroxysmally until alpha capped.
additionalDifferentials: Prolactinoma versus stalk effect by levels and shrinkage
Cushing disease versus ectopic by high dose suppression
Conn versus secondary aldosteronism by renin
additionalInvestigations: Prolactin with MRI sella in galactorrhoea
OGTT with IGF-1 in coarse facies
Metanephrines with adrenal CT in paroxysmal hypertension
